name: Regions (cities) of China

rules.authority: The cities this version prices, keyed by `entity.region`: every city-varying parameter (contribution bases and rates, housing-fund limits, minimum wages by zone, the wage base for overtime and leave pay, sick-pay scale, medical period, high-temperature pay, work-injury subsidy months, union-fund schedule and the local filing days) with its sources. Rules read `rules.regions.by_region[company.region]`; an entity whose region is not a row is refused. A new city is a new row.

SH.name: 上海 Shanghai
sources: 社会保险 base limits: 上海市人力资源和社会保障局 2025 / 2026 contribution-year notices (7460–37302 to 2026-06; 7546–37731 from 2026-07) https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tgsgg_17341/20260818/t0035_1443203.html
医疗保险 9% / 2%: 沪医保规〔2025〕2号, 沪医保规〔2026〕2号 https://ybj.sh.gov.cn/gfxwj/20260313/921e047144694b61b6df8ca0c5ef2cfc.html
失业保险: 沪人社规〔2024〕25号 第一条 (0.5% / 0.5% to 2025-12-31); 2026 by owner ruling
住房公积金 5–7%, supplementary 1–5%, base 2690 / 2740 – 37302 / 37731: 上海市住房公积金管理委员会 annual notices (沪公积金管委会〔2026〕3号)
最低工资 2740 / hourly 25 (net of the employee's contributions): 沪人社规〔2025〕10号 https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tgzfl_17732/20250714/t0035_1434097.html
加班 / 假期工资 base and floor: 上海市企业工资支付办法 第九条 (沪人社综发〔2016〕29号; 沪人社规〔2026〕10号)
病假工资 scale: 沪劳保发〔1995〕83号; 医疗期 3 months + 1 per year, max 24
高温津贴 300 a month June–September: 沪人社规 高温津贴通知
工伤 voluntary single-scheme cover for interns and over-age workers (from 2025-12-01); 一次性伤残就业补助金 18/15/12/9/6/3 months, less 20% a year within 5 years of retirement: 沪府令第93号 第四十条、第四十一条
工会经费 by the 15th, preparatory organisations included: 上海市工会条例 第四十一条 https://www.shanghai.gov.cn/nw5652/20200905/0001-5652_362.html
SI payment by the 15th; 缴费工资 declaration 1 May – 25 June (国家税务总局上海市税务局通告2026年第1号); HPF base adjusted from 1 July; 残保金 declared by 31 October; final wages at termination

工会经费 monthly, the month after; 建会筹备金 for a unit without a union, quarterly periods: 云南省实施《工会法》办法 第二十七条; 云工通〔2021〕1号

name: Social insurance monthly declaration and payment

rules.description: Declare and pay the month's social insurance with the employee shares withheld. Due: SH by the 15th of the contribution month, KM by the 20th.
rules.authority: 社会保险法 第六十条第一款; 社会保险费征缴暂行条例 第十条. SH: 国家税务总局上海市税务局等五部门公告2023年第2号 (自2023年12月1日): "用人单位应当于每月15日前自行向税务部门申报缴纳社会保险费" https://shanghai.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfw/zcfgk/sbf/202311/t469352.html. KM: 国家税务总局云南省税务局公告2023年第5号 (自2023年7月1日): 用人单位应当于每月20日前申报应缴费额并缴纳社会保险费 https://zc.51shebao.com/detail/795061.

name: Housing provident fund monthly remittance

rules.description: Remit the housing provident fund within 5 days of the wage day (the run's pay day; the period end when the run has none).
rules.authority: 住房公积金管理条例 第十九条第一款: 职工个人缴存的住房公积金, 由所在单位每月从其工资中代扣代缴; 单位应当于每月发放职工工资之日起5日内将单位缴存的和为职工代缴的住房公积金汇缴到住房公积金专户内.
rules.due: add_days((has(run.pay_date) && run.pay_date != null && run.pay_date != "" ? run.pay_date : period.to), 5)

name: IIT withholding declaration and payment

rules.description: File the withholding return and pay the IIT withheld. The period is the month the wages are paid (run pay day, else the period end); due by the 15th of the next month as extended by the national filing calendar (2026: 20 Jan, 24 Feb, 16 Mar, 20 Apr, 22 May, 15 Jun, 15 Jul, 17 Aug, 15 Sep, 26 Oct, 16 Nov, 15 Dec).
rules.authority: 个人所得税法 第十四条第一款 (次月十五日内缴入国库并报送扣缴申报表); 个人所得税扣缴申报管理办法(试行) 第六条 (按月预扣, 所属期为支付月份); 税收征收管理法实施细则 第一百零九条 (期限的最后一日是法定休假日的, 以休假日期满的次日为期限的最后一日; 在期限内有连续3日以上法定休假日的, 按休假日天数顺延); 国家税务总局办公厅《关于明确2026年度申报纳税期限的通知》(税总办征科函〔2025〕64号) https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102424/c5245729/content.html.

name: Annual income and withholding statement to employees

rules.description: Give each employee their prior-year wage income and the tax withheld. Raised on the January run; due by the end of February.
rules.authority: 国家税务总局《个人所得税扣缴申报管理办法(试行)》(公告2018年第61号) 第十三条: 支付工资、薪金所得的扣缴义务人应当于年度终了后两个月内, 向纳税人提供其个人所得和已扣缴税款等信息.

name: IIT annual reconciliation (综合所得汇算清缴)

rules.description: Annual reconciliation of the prior year's comprehensive income from 1 March to 30 June; the employer files it for the employees who entrust it to them. Raised on the March run; due 30 June.
rules.authority: 个人所得税法 第十一条第一款: 居民个人取得综合所得, 按年计算个人所得税; 有扣缴义务人的, 由扣缴义务人按月或者按次预扣预缴税款; 需要办理汇算清缴的, 应当在取得所得的次年三月一日至六月三十日内办理汇算清缴; 第十二条. 国家税务总局《个人所得税综合所得汇算清缴管理办法》(国家税务总局令第57号, 2025年2月26日施行) 第五条 (三月一日至六月三十日), 第十四条第二项 (单位代为办理须经纳税人确认, 未确认的单位不得代为办理), 第十六条 (资料留存5年).

name: Social insurance registration of a new employee

rules.description: Apply to the social insurance agency to register the new employee. Due: within 30 days of the start of employment.
rules.authority: 社会保险法 第五十八条第一款: 用人单位应当自用工之日起三十日内为其职工向社会保险经办机构申请办理社会保险登记.

name: Housing provident fund deposit registration

rules.description: Register the new employee's housing provident fund deposit and open the personal account. Due: within 30 days of hiring.
rules.authority: 住房公积金管理条例 第十五条第一款: 单位录用职工的, 应当自录用之日起30日内向住房公积金管理中心办理缴存登记, 并办理职工住房公积金账户的设立或者转移手续.

name: Written labour contract

rules.description: Conclude a written labour contract. Due: within one month of the start of employment; after that the employer owes double wages (第八十二条).
rules.authority: 劳动合同法 第十条第二款: 已建立劳动关系, 未同时订立书面劳动合同的, 应当自用工之日起一个月内订立书面劳动合同; 第八十二条第一款.

name: Employee roster entry (职工名册)

rules.description: Enter the employee in the employee roster kept for inspection. Due: from the start of employment.
rules.authority: 劳动合同法 第七条: 用人单位自用工之日起即与劳动者建立劳动关系; 用人单位应当建立职工名册备查; 劳动合同法实施条例 第八条 (名册内容).

name: Termination certificate

rules.description: Issue the certificate of termination of the labour contract. Due: when the contract ends.
rules.authority: 劳动合同法 第五十条第一款: 用人单位应当在解除或者终止劳动合同时出具解除或者终止劳动合同的证明; 劳动合同法实施条例 第二十四条 (证明内容).
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

name: Personnel file and social insurance transfer

rules.description: Complete the transfer of the personnel file and the social insurance relationship. Due: within 15 days of termination.
rules.authority: 劳动合同法 第五十条第一款: 并在十五日内为劳动者办理档案和社会保险关系转移手续.
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

name: Housing provident fund change registration on exit

rules.description: Register the end of the employment with the housing provident fund centre (seal or transfer the account). Due: within 30 days of termination.
rules.authority: 住房公积金管理条例 第十五条第二款: 单位与职工终止劳动关系的, 单位应当自劳动关系终止之日起30日内向住房公积金管理中心办理变更登记, 并办理职工住房公积金账户转移或者封存手续.
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

name: Final wages

rules.description: Pay the leaver's wages in full. Due: SH at the termination; KM within 5 working days of it.
rules.authority: 工资支付暂行规定 第九条: 劳动关系双方依法解除或终止劳动合同时, 用人单位应在解除或终止劳动合同时一次付清劳动者工资. KM: 昆明市工资支付条例 (2019年9月1日施行) 第十三条: "自劳动关系终止或者解除之日起5个工作日内一次性付清劳动者工资" https://policy.mofcom.gov.cn/claw/clawContent.shtml?id=67457. SH: 上海市企业工资支付办法 (沪人社规〔2026〕10号) 第七条, on termination.
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

name: Economic compensation payment

rules.description: Pay the economic compensation on the grounds 第四十六条 makes it owing: the employer proposing a mutual termination (MUTUAL_EMPLOYER_PROPOSED), 第三十八条 employer default, 第四十条 incapacity, 第四十一条 layoff, bankruptcy or closure (第四十四条第四、五项), and fixed-term expiry unless the employee refused renewal on equal or better terms (`exit_facts.employee_refused_renewal_on_equal_terms`). Due when the handover is completed.
rules.authority: 劳动合同法 第四十六条, 第五十条第二款: 用人单位依照本法有关规定应当向劳动者支付经济补偿的, 在办结工作交接时支付.
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

name: Retention of the terminated labour contract

rules.description: Keep the text of the terminated or expired labour contract for at least two years for inspection.
rules.authority: 劳动合同法 第五十条第三款: 用人单位对已经解除或者终止的劳动合同的文本, 至少保存二年备查.
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

name: Foreign employee work permit and work-type residence permit

rules.description: Obtain the work permit and work-type residence permit before a foreign national (nationality other than CN; Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan residents no longer need one) starts work. Due: before the start of employment.
rules.authority: 出境入境管理法 第四十一条: 外国人在中国境内工作, 应当按照规定取得工作许可和工作类居留证件; 任何单位和个人不得聘用未取得工作许可和工作类居留证件的外国人; 国务院《关于取消台港澳人员在内地就业许可事项的决定》(国发〔2018〕28号).
rules.applies_when: employee != null && employee.nationality != null && employee.nationality != "" && !(employee.nationality in ["CN", "HK", "MO", "TW"])

name: Economic layoff: explanation to the union or all staff and report to the labour authority

rules.description: For a layoff of 20 or more, or fewer than 20 but 10% or more of the workforce: explain the situation to the union or all employees 30 days in advance, hear their opinions, and report the layoff plan to the labour administration. Raised per leaver when the batch (`exit_facts.layoff_batch_size`) reaches 20 or 10% of the workforce (`headcount`); an unrecorded batch raises it. Due: 30 days before the layoff.
rules.authority: 劳动合同法 第四十一条第一款: 需要裁减人员二十人以上或者裁减不足二十人但占企业职工总数百分之十以上的, 用人单位提前三十日向工会或者全体职工说明情况, 听取工会或者职工的意见后, 裁减人员方案经向劳动行政部门报告, 可以裁减人员.
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

name: Thirty days' written notice (or a month's wage) for a 第四十条 termination

rules.description: Give the employee 30 days' written notice, or pay one month's wage in lieu (PAY_IN_LIEU_OF_NOTICE), before terminating under 第四十条 (illness or injury, incompetence, changed objective circumstances). Due: 30 days before the termination.
rules.authority: 劳动合同法 第四十条: 用人单位提前三十日以书面形式通知劳动者本人或者额外支付劳动者一个月工资后, 可以解除劳动合同; 劳动合同法实施条例 第二十条 (额外支付的工资按照该劳动者上一个月的工资标准确定).
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

name: Annual contribution-wage declaration

rules.description: Declare every insured employee's prior-calendar-year monthly average wage. Shanghai: for the July–June contribution year, raised on the May run, due 25 June (2026: 1 May – 25 June). Kunming (Yunnan): for the calendar year from January, one wage for all five insurances, raised on the December run, due 31 January (2026: 1 – 31 January). The window is set by each year's notice.
rules.authority: 国家税务总局上海市税务局通告2026年第1号《关于开展2026社保年度用人单位社会保险缴费工资申报工作的通告》: 申报时间2026年5月1日至2026年6月25日; 申报职工上一自然年度的月平均工资 https://shanghai.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfw/zcfgk/sbf/202604/t480144.html. KM: 国家税务总局云南省税务局 (云南税务 WeChat account, 2026-01-08) 《“社保费管理客户端”年度缴费工资申报操作指引——企业申报操作篇》: 企业2026年度社保费缴费工资集中申报截止时间为1月31日; 自2026年1月起, 企业缴费工资申报实现“一次申报、五险并用” https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzA5NjY5OTEzNQ==&mid=2652065121&idx=1&sn=17e0daa2e4587ecf31522fb0cdce28fa; 国家税务总局西双版纳州税务局 (西双版纳税务, 2026-01-09) 《关于2026年用人单位社会保险费缴费工资申报的提示》: 2026年1月1日至1月31日为用人单位社会保险费缴费工资集中申报期; 各险种新申报缴费工资自2026年1月开始执行; 以职工本人上年度月平均工资据实申报 https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzI5MTI4NDU3OQ==&mid=2247539265&idx=1&sn=11392640847f8a342c8ba029ee49ccba (both read 2026-10-08). The 2026 Kunming medical notice (禄劝县医疗保障局 2026-09-16, 2026年度昆明市职工医疗保险有关基数执行标准通知) moves only the base limits (4403–22017 from September 2026) and sets no declaration window.
rules.applies_when: (company != null && company.region in rules.regions.by_region) && rules.regions.by_region[company.region].si_base_declaration != null && period.from.substring(5, 7) == rules.regions.by_region[company.region].si_base_declaration.month

name: Employment registration of a new hire

rules.description: Register the employment with the public employment service. Due: within 30 days of hiring.
rules.authority: 就业服务与就业管理规定 第六十二条第一款: 用人单位招用人员后, 应当于录用之日起30日内办理登记手续 (北京市人力资源和社会保障局2024年清单引用条文) https://rsj.beijing.gov.cn/xxgk/2024zcwj/202406/W020240617387510280074.docx

name: Employment deregistration on exit

rules.description: Register the end of the employment with the public employment service. Due: within 15 days of termination.
rules.authority: 就业服务与就业管理规定 第六十二条第一款: 用人单位与职工终止或者解除劳动关系后, 应当于15日内办理登记手续.
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

name: Work-injury recognition application

rules.description: Apply to the social insurance administration for work-injury recognition. Raised when a WORK_INJURY_LEAVE entry is created; due 30 days after the accident (`facts.accident_date`, else the entry day).
rules.authority: 工伤保险条例 第十七条第一款: 职工发生事故伤害或者按照职业病防治法规定被诊断、鉴定为职业病, 所在单位应当自事故伤害发生之日或者被诊断、鉴定为职业病之日起30日内, 向统筹地区社会保险行政部门提出工伤认定申请.
rules.when: row != null && row.catalog_code == "WORK_INJURY_LEAVE"

name: Employer social insurance registration

rules.description: Register the new employer for social insurance. Due: within 30 days of its establishment (`established_on`).
rules.authority: 社会保险法 第五十七条第一款: 用人单位应当自成立之日起三十日内凭营业执照、登记证书或者单位印章, 向当地社会保险经办机构申请办理社会保险登记.

name: Employer social insurance change registration

rules.description: Register a change of the employer's registered particulars (its name) with social insurance within 30 days.
rules.authority: 社会保险法 第五十七条第二款: 用人单位的社会保险登记事项发生变更或者用人单位依法终止的, 应当自变更或者终止之日起三十日内, 到社会保险经办机构办理变更或者注销社会保险登记 https://yjglt.yn.gov.cn/html/2024/yunnanshengwenjian_0507/28616.html.
rules.when: row != null && has(row.before) && row.before != null && "name" in row.before

name: Employer housing provident fund registration

rules.description: Register the new employer with the housing provident fund centre and open its account. Due: within 30 days of its establishment.
rules.authority: 住房公积金管理条例 第十四条第一款: 新设立的单位应当自设立之日起30日内向住房公积金管理中心办理住房公积金缴存登记, 并自登记之日起20日内, 为本单位职工办理住房公积金账户设立手续.

name: Minimum wage (最低工资)

name: Personal-information notice to the new employee

rules.description: Before processing a new employee's personal information, tell them who processes it, for what purpose and how, which kinds, how long it is kept, and how to exercise their rights; for sensitive information also its necessity and effect.

name: Separate consent and impact assessment for sensitive personal information

rules.description: Obtain the employee's separate consent and record a personal-information impact assessment before processing sensitive information — health data (medical certificates), bank accounts, and the data of children under 14 for the special deductions.
rules.authority: 个人信息保护法 第二十八条 (医疗健康、金融账户、不满十四周岁未成年人的个人信息为敏感个人信息), 第二十九条 (单独同意), 第五十五条第(一)项 (事前个人信息保护影响评估) https://www.cac.gov.cn/2021-08/20/c_1631050028355286.htm.

name: Separate consent for a medical certificate

rules.description: A sick-leave or work-injury record carries health data: hold the employee's separate consent for it.
rules.authority: 个人信息保护法 第二十八条、第二十九条 https://www.cac.gov.cn/2021-08/20/c_1631050028355286.htm.
rules.when: row != null && has(row.catalog_code) && row.catalog_code in ["SICK_LEAVE", "WORK_INJURY_LEAVE", "MATERNITY_LEAVE"]

name: Notice and separate consent for an HR transfer abroad

rules.description: An entity that sends employee data to an overseas group (`transfers_hr_data_abroad`) for cross-border HR management under its labour rules is exempt from the security assessment, standard contract and certification, but must still tell the employee the recipient and purpose, obtain separate consent and record an impact assessment.

name: Periodic personal-information compliance audit

name: Register a juvenile worker and the pre-job health check

rules.description: A worker aged 16–17 at hire: register with the county labour authority (未成年工登记证) and have the health check before the post is assigned.
rules.authority: 未成年工特殊保护规定 (劳部发〔1994〕498号) 第二条, 第六条第(一)项, 第九条; 劳动法 第五十八条、第六十五条 https://yjglt.yn.gov.cn/html/2024/yunnanshengwenjian_0507/28616.html.

name: Juvenile worker health check after a year of work

rules.description: A juvenile worker still under 18 on the first anniversary of hire: the health check after one year of work.
rules.authority: 未成年工特殊保护规定 第六条第(二)项 https://yjglt.yn.gov.cn/html/2024/yunnanshengwenjian_0507/28616.html.

name: Open-ended contract on the employee's request after 10 years

rules.description: Ten years of continuous service on a fixed-term contract: if the employee asks for or agrees to a renewal, conclude an open-ended contract unless they ask for a fixed term. A reminder on the anniversary; the OPEN_ENDED_REQUIRED validation refuses a fixed-term renewal after 10 years or two consecutive fixed terms.
rules.authority: 劳动合同法 第十四条第二款第(一)项 https://yjglt.yn.gov.cn/html/2024/yunnanshengwenjian_0507/28616.html.
rules.when: today == add_years(hired_on, 10) && contract != null && has(contract.effective_range) && contract.effective_range.to != null

name: Social insurance paid late: the 0.05% daily surcharge

rules.description: The social insurance remittance was settled after its due day: pay the surcharge of 0.05% of the amount for each day from the due day; it may not be charged to employees.
rules.authority: 社会保险法 第八十六条: 自欠缴之日起, 按日加收万分之五的滞纳金; 社会保险费征缴暂行条例 第二十条 https://yjglt.yn.gov.cn/html/2024/yunnanshengwenjian_0507/28616.html.
